057a SCOPE
1. Cancellation propagation audit across Primary, format repair, Brain, Brain repair/restore and selected suspend cleanup/query paths.
2. Owner cancellation is authoritative via currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive(), even if a lower layer translates it to IOException/provider failure; child CancellationException remains an operation failure when the owner is active.
3. Action transaction hard deadline with explicit stages and diagnostics.
4. Timeout is distinct from user cancellation; TimeoutCancellationException cannot mask owner cancellation.
5. First pre-dispatch capture moved inside the single action deadline, closing the observed PLAN_ACCEPT -> silent capture gap.
6. PREPARED stale/timeout/cancel before ATTEMPTED may clear only the exact task+sequence PREPARED record and trigger bounded fresh replan.
7. ATTEMPTED or later is never auto-cleared/replayed by 057a; existing RC11 recovery remains authoritative.
8. 056 Stop/Close routing and V54 cancellable OkHttp bridge preserved.
9. Intent parsing, Samsung TransitionWaiter, screenshot-window fix, and implicit semantic admissibility intentionally excluded from 057a.

EXTERNAL CROSS-CHECKS
- kotlinx.coroutines official source/docs: CancellationException semantics; ensureActive to distinguish owner cancellation from child cancellation; TimeoutCancellationException is cancellation-based; prompt cancellation behavior.
- Kotlin kotlinx.coroutines issue #1814: stdlib runCatching may swallow CancellationException.
- Android Accessibility official docs: accessibility nodes/windows can become stale; TYPE_WINDOWS_CHANGED is system-sourced and should be correlated by windowId/getWindows.
- AndroidX UiAutomator 2.4: bounded waitForStableInActiveWindow validates later 057b stabilization design but is not mixed into 057a.
- AndroidClaw: active Job cancellation with dedicated CancellationException path and rethrow.
- react-native-device-agent/Deft: observe -> act -> settle -> fresh observe; bounded wait_for_node / wait_for_change.
- dsh-mobile-gui-agent: explicit observing/executing/verifying phases, per-action timeout, fresh post-action observation, authoritative stop, stale-element revalidation.
- Zero-Permission Manipulation / Action Rebinding: reinforces preserving fresh pre-dispatch revalidation.
- VeriSafe / V-Droid: supports later semantic action verification/admissibility, deliberately deferred to 058.
